metadata.description: Agent skills that kill AI slop: rough asks become ready-to-run prompts and specs for any model, and UI briefs become enterprise-grade screens.

plugins.name: wellasked
plugins.description: Turn a rough request into a ready-to-run prompt, build spec or system prompt for any model or coding agent. At most 3 questions, each with a recommended default.

plugins.name: enterprise-ui
plugins.description: Build, brief or review enterprise-grade UI: data tables, forms, dashboards and admin screens with every state covered, WCAG 2.2 AA, and a never-list for generic AI looks.

plugins.name: prompt-review
plugins.description: Review a prompt, system prompt, spec, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or SKILL.md before it ships. Findings by severity, each with a quote and a fix, and a verdict. Does not rewrite unless asked.

plugins.name: prompt-port
plugins.description: Move a working prompt or agent file to another model, vendor or tool. A change ledger accounts for every source instruction, and equivalence tests check the port.

plugins.name: prompt-evals
plugins.description: Write a small golden set and pass/fail checks for any prompt or agent, with no framework or vendor needed. Code checks first, yes/no model graders only when needed.

plugins.name: agent-gates
plugins.description: Write the ask-before-you-act section of AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md from the repository's real commands, plus the permission settings that enforce it.
